summary: FD_TC_021_Case in Queue | DDS Runs | Eligible | Welcome Back Triggered
title: Case in Queue | DDS Runs | Eligible | Welcome Back Triggered
description:
Customer files claim before 72 hours have elapsed since the flight. DDS data is not yet available. System creates case in pending state, polls DDS daily for up to 14 days. When data arrives, sends deep link notification for customer to return and complete claim. Validates the pre-72hr intake and polling mechanism.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Mathieu Roy), 1 leg AC domestic YUL?YYZ. Itinerary: 4hr delay, Arrival delay code: Pending, Controllable. Filing time: 48 hours after flight (within 72hr window). DDS data: NOT YET AVAILABLE at time of filing. Trip Tracer: Data will become available at D+4 (after 72hrs).
